question: Tanjore Bala saraswati was a prominent dancer of which form of Indian Classical Dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Tanjore Bala Saraswati was a renowned practitioner of **Bharatanatyam**, a classical dance form originating from Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• She is celebrated for her contributions to **reviving and popularizing Bharatanatyam** during the 20th century.
 
• Bala Saraswati performed internationally, bringing global recognition to Bharatanatyam.
 
• Her performances were known for their depth of expression, technical precision, and adherence to traditional elements.
 
• She received numerous awards and accolades, including the **Padma Bhushan** in 1957 and the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** in 1955.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam:**

 
 
• It is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, originating from the temples of Tamil Nadu.
 
• Bharatanatyam is characterized by its fixed upper torso, bent legs, intricate footwork, hand gestures (mudras), and facial expressions.
 
• The dance form is deeply rooted in Hindu religious themes and spiritual ideas, often depicting stories from Indian epics and mythology.
 
 
 
• **Padma Bhushan:**
 
 
• It is the third-highest civilian award in India, established in 1954.
 
• It is awarded to recognize distinguished service of a high order to the nation, in any field.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award:**
 
 
• This award is conferred by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy of Music, Dance, and Drama.
 
• It recognizes outstanding achievement in the performing arts.
 
 
 
• **Abhinaya:**
 
 
• It refers to the art of expression in Indian classical dance.
 
• Abhinaya includes facial expressions, gestures, and body movements used to convey emotions and narrate stories.
